title: Mouse in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='36' r='14' fill='#b06a8a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='14' fill='#b06a8a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='36' r='9' fill='#e8a0c0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='9' fill='#e8a0c0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#9b8cc4'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='47' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#e8708a'/>
  <!-- nose shine -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='57.3' rx='1' ry='0.7' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='57' x2='42' y2='60' stroke='#c4b8e0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='62' x2='42' y2='62' stroke='#c4b8e0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='57' x2='58' y2='60' stroke='#c4b8e0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='71' y1='62' x2='58' y2='62' stroke='#c4b8e0' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M28 68 Q50 78 72 68 L70 78 Q50 88 30 78 Z' fill='#e85a4f'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M33 72 Q50 80 67 72' stroke='#ffcf6b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M68 76 L76 92 L68 94 L62 78 Z' fill='#e85a4f'/>
  <path d='M66 84 L74 86' stroke='#ffcf6b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#9b8cc4'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='80' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c4b8e0'/>
</svg>
